page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head at the top, the page number at the top right and a catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: excelsum & arduum, ut cum ex se, tum ex accidenti, haereticorum nempe protervia, difficultatem pepererint semper maxi-mam. Hinc [illegible, ~9 letters] Petri dubio pro-cul tempore indignari, & dicam scribere Paulo, nec ferre legis in speciem contemptum; Hinc Anomaeorum illa colluvies legem arguere, criminari, usum omnem proscribere; Hinc saepe Patres in Episto-la enarranda vel parciores, vel certe minus felices; Hinc hodieque Sociniani va-riis ex locis propugnare discrimen essen-tiale utriusque foederis; de Christi dispu-tare Sacerdotio, ut mere figurato, analo-gia quadam cum Levitico, ut in coelis de-mum obeundo, ut vix a Regno distinc-to, nisi in quantum ibi principium imperans, hic exequens &c. Hinc Pontificij latebras hincinde, sacrificio suo missatico, aliisque id genus hypothesibus salvandis, sectari anxie, ne refricem aliorum ulcera.
V. Quartò accenseri iisdem possunt, quae [illegible, ~9 letters], & in speciem aliena à Veteri Testamento, passim exhibentur. V.g. ubi Cap. 1. ad generationem Christi trahit.

page.notes: The Greek phrase near "Hinc" in the first paragraph and the Greek word after "quae" in the last paragraph are too blurred to read letter by letter, so both are marked illegible. The word "Sociniani" is read from the scan as printed. The word "locum" at the foot is the catchword and "E 2" is the signature.
